summary: 32-year-old woman with 3 months of epigastric burning after meals, no alarm features, no NSAIDs. NICE CG184 / Maastricht VI: H. pylori test-and-treat (or 4 weeks of full-dose PPI); no endoscopy.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Burning pain in the upper abdomen after meals
inputs.hpi: Three months of burning upper abdominal discomfort after meals with bloating and belching. Antacids help a little. Weight steady, eating normally, swallowing normal, stools normal colour. No vomiting. Takes no anti-inflammatories. No family history of stomach cancer.

exam.abdomen: Soft, mild epigastric tenderness, no mass.

inputs.socialHistory: Nurse. Non-smoker. Coffee 4 cups a day. Alcohol occasional.

guideline.name: NICE CG184 — Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease and dyspepsia in adults: investigation and management
guideline.section: Uninvestigated dyspepsia without alarm features: lifestyle advice; offer either H. pylori test-and-treat or full-dose PPI for 4 weeks (either first); endoscopy only per NG12 criteria
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Clinical guideline CG184. London: NICE; 2014 (last updated 2019).

guideline.name: Maastricht VI/Florence consensus report — management of Helicobacter pylori infection
guideline.section: Test-and-treat strategy for uninvestigated dyspepsia in young patients without alarm features; urea breath test or monoclonal stool antigen; stop PPI 2 weeks before testing
guideline.citation: Malfertheiner P, Megraud F, Rokkas T, et al. Gut. 2022;71:1724–1762.

guideline.name: NICE NG12 — Suspected cancer: recognition and referral (oesophageal and stomach cancer)
guideline.section: No NG12 criterion met (age <55, no weight loss, no dysphagia)
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. NICE guideline NG12. London: NICE; 2015 (last updated 2023).

rationale: Base dyspepsia case at the benign end. Measures over-investigation and over-triage: a guideline-concordant consultation stays routine and chooses non-invasive H. pylori testing or empirical PPI.
